name: Reunion
source:
You play the role of a 27-year-old man who returns to his hometown after nearly 10 years to hear his father's last will and testament. You control the protagonist as he attempts to exact revenge on Linda, the woman who ruined his life, because of whom he had to leave town and leave his family and closest friends.

Plotting his revenge, the protagonist falls deeper and deeper into the world of secrets of his father, discovering things he never had any clue about. The protagonist will have to  come face-to-face the past as well as with dark side of his hometown and finally, after many years, close this chapter of his life.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/karabinek]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个27岁的男人，时隔近10年后回到家乡，聆听父亲的遗嘱。你控制主角，试图向毁掉他生活的女人琳达报仇，因为她，他不得不离开小镇，离开他的家人和最亲密的朋友。

主人公在密谋复仇的过程中，越陷越深，陷入父亲的秘密世界，发现了一些他从未有过的线索。主人公将要面对过去的过去，面对家乡的阴暗面，并在多年之后，最终结束人生的这一章。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/karabinek]Patreon[/url]]
